bounds: Database-backed mobile App Auth client registration; boolean presence in DB, enabled status, app active/approved authority, and redirect URI matching without environment fallback.
limitations: Covers database client registration resolution and authority checks. Low-level PKCE verifier hashing and cryptography are proven separately in repository tests.
Database presence is the sole authority; there is no environment fallback.
Disabled clients or unapproved apps in the database fail closed.
